entries.summary: Biden's presidency is seen as illegitimate by about half the country.
entries.quote: Joe Biden's term opens the era of the asterisk presidency, when the occupant of the Oval Office is seen as illegitimate by roughly half the country … and by the lawmakers these election skeptics send to Congress.

entries.label: Long COVID
entries.summary: The pandemic and its wide effects persist after vaccination starts.
entries.quote: Neither the coronavirus nor its wide-ranging impacts will disappear once widespread vaccination begins.

entries.label: Climate: Net zero meets G-Zero
entries.summary: The energy transition is driven by competition, not coordination.
entries.quote: Beyond the headlines, the energy transition will be dominated by competition and a lack of coordination.

entries.label: US-China tensions broaden
entries.summary: Alliances, vaccine diplomacy and climate technology widen US-China friction.
entries.quote: US efforts to enlist allies, vaccine diplomacy, and climate tech competition will further complicate US-China relations.

entries.label: Global data reckoning
entries.summary: Competition over data becomes a new geopolitical contest.
entries.quote: To those who say that data is the new oil: Here comes the new Great Game.

entries.label: Cyber tipping point
entries.summary: Cyber conflict creates unprecedented technological and geopolitical risk in 2021.
entries.quote: A combination of low-probability, high-impact risks and inexorable technology trends make 2021 the year that cyber conflict will create unprecedented technological and geopolitical risk.

entries.label: (Out in the) cold Turkey
entries.summary: Erdogan's foreign adventures hurt Turkey's economy.

entries.label: Middle East: Low oil takes a toll

entries.quote: Energy prices will remain low, keeping the pressure on governments that already faced instability.

entries.label: Europe after Merkel
entries.summary: Merkel's departure is Europe's top risk.
entries.quote: Angela Merkel has been Europe's most important leader, and her impending departure drives the continent's top risk.

entries.label: Latin America disappoints
entries.summary: Latin America is the second biggest regional loser from the pandemic.
entries.quote: The Middle East is the obvious big coronavirus crisis loser among the world's regions; but Latin America is a clear second.
